reviews.text: 我是四字手游高手，让我看看这游戏是怎么个事。 这地图真一眼祖玛啊，玩起来挺新颖的。
Easy to operate and simple to get started, you can leave it running while you take a break. Looking forward to future updates.

The way enemies get blown to bits is super satisfying. It brings me back to my tower defense days as a kid. There’s actually a good amount of content, but the graphics are just okay. Hope the devs add more gameplay variety
Good foundation, but the gameplay feels clunky right now. I'd wait for a few updates.
There are quite a lot of turret options with different functions and attributes. If you plan your layout in advance, they can automatically upgrade and defend. The controls are also quite simple.
这游戏怎么说才好呢，总体质感还行，打击感和音效也不错，但总感觉26.1的价格不是很值，有点偏高了。
糟糕的游戏，它的商店封面很吸引人，但是实际购买后游玩的体验很糟糕，打了3个小时还是和刚开始的玩法差不多，我不知道到底在玩什么，感觉就是重复加上重复，更糟糕的是我无法申请退款了

I've played a lot of tower defense games and this is very basic for a basic one. The on sale price is the only way I would even consider recommending it for someone who thinks it may look interesting . It plays a lot more basic than it looks. This one is a dud in my opinion.
游戏质量只能说一般，内容不够丰富，后面大多都是材料的堆砌，到后面就有些烦躁了
机甲科幻风的塔防游戏，完成度不错，数值平衡较好，后期重复度有点高，希望后续更新更多内容。
游戏教程还可以，但是单位分类不明显，仅仅是按照数据不同进行分类，功能性分类没有，需要自己看单位的功能性，比较烦，选择地图的时候也不显示地图怪物的走向，需要进去开一把才知道，才能进行针对性布置。还需要后续更多的改进优化
前期确实上头，5x5格子怎么摆部新鲜。但玩几小时后就会发现套路大同小异，重复感强。内容撑不起这个价格，感觉更像半成品，建议观望
玩法算还行，但是这花花绿绿的特效是什么鬼？想突出科技科幻也不一定是要把一堆高光粒子堆叠到一起吧，，，不知道制作组是不是第一次做游戏，还是多看看同类的优秀案例吧，，，
平衡稀烂，有些炮塔强得离谱，有些弱得想笑。论坛里逛一圈，清一色同一套阵容。那设计师做这么多炮塔干啥？充数的吗？

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44181848/] 【更多适合Steam Deck的好游戏推荐，请关注GPD掌机鉴赏家！】[/url] 让人眼前一亮的科幻塔防游戏。在5×5的格子上自由布局各种机甲炮塔，对抗特性各异的敌人，策略感十足。炮塔种类丰富，搭配组合千变万化，战前布局的每一步都需要仔细斟酌，是策略爱好者的福音。 游戏提供了自动升级的挂机选项，休闲解压；也可以选择手动操作，挑战更高上限。多种地图和进阶难度保证了足够的可玩性。作为一款小体量游戏，其内容扎实，性价比很高。 当然，游戏在画面精细度和部分炮塔的平衡性上还有提升空间，后期玩法也稍显重复。但总体而言，它绝对是一款合格且有趣的塔防作品，非常适合用来打发零碎时间，享受部署与歼灭的快感。
我以为我是钢铁侠，结果发现自己只是个在5x5格子里摆地摊的包工头。

A pure tower defense game with low overall difficulty and easy-to-learn mechanics. It features a wide variety of tower types, allowing for diverse and creative combinations. The game offers a multitude of maps to choose from, ensuring high-quality content.

The game combines tower defense with Vampire Survivors-style gameplay, which makes it quite interesting. However, the difficulty is relatively low, and it lacks depth at the moment. Hopefully, future updates will introduce more engaging mechanics and gameplay elements.

It gets pretty fun later on and is a rather stress-relieving tower defense game. Watching wave after wave of monsters die feels great. Hopefully they can add more maps because there aren't enough to play.

This sci-fi tower defense is a huge upgrade from the previous game—more maps, deeper strategy, and cool mech roguelite vibes. Love the resource combos and tactical pre-planning. Graphics are a bit rough, but hoping for Workshop. Perfect for casual fun.

Mech Fortress is a standout sci-fi tower defense title that packs immense strategic depth into a compact 5x5 grid. Mastering the synergy between 72 unique turrets—ranging from front-line tanks to specialized supports—turns every layout into a rewarding puzzle. The game caters to all, offering a relaxing auto-upgrade mode for casual play and a demanding manual mode for tacticians. With diverse maps and evolving enemy mechanics, the progression feels meaningful and constantly challenges your resource management skills. Despite its minimalist indie visuals, the addictive gameplay loop and high replayability make it an essential, high-value experience for any strategy fan.

The game is quite good overall, featuring a wide selection of maps where each enemy type has its own unique characteristics.The gameplay is also solid; you can freely arrange units on the grid, and unlock more turrets through combat.

This mech combat game delivers intense, fast-paced action with smooth controls and responsive feedback. Every battle feels weighty and satisfying, with zero lag or bugs ruining the flow. The mech designs are stunning, and the gameplay stays immersive from start to finish.
本来以为是一个简简单单的摸鱼挂机游戏，没想到后面整难度那么大，这谁顶得住啊
挺好玩的塔防游戏，还有自动升级，可以挂机就很舒服
攻击特效和打击感都很爽，前期可以轻松挂机升级，后期需要研究搭配
游戏最让我这种懒人狂喜的是它的挂机系统。战斗前把阵型摆好，点一下开始就能全程挂机，看着自己的防御塔自动升级、收割敌人，摸鱼的时候来一把简直不要太爽。
战旗风格的塔防，不是很喜欢，价格有一点点高，整体上不喜欢。
这塔防有点意思，格子设计虽说不是很大，但很考验规划策略，机甲炮塔开火很炫酷，组合起来火力网一开，小怪直接蒸发，挺解压爽快的！比较适合上班摸鱼来一把，轻松解压~。塔防爱好者可以考虑入手！
价格亲民，二十多块钱能玩挺久。自动升级解放双手，手动调布局又能玩出不同花样。就是背包检索和操作有点繁琐，希望后续更新能优化下界面和操作流程。
这塔防还挺上头，摆好阵容就能挂机，炮塔种类不少，特效也还行。就是画面有点糙，但打发时间足够了。
机甲塔防的核心玩法挺有意思，但画面表现比较粗糙，部分炮台强弱失衡，后期难度起伏过大，后续更新还需要持续打磨优化。
塔防爽游，但是挂机 画风炫酷，解压上头 后期难度提升很快，虽然但是也能用别人的布局码逃课
推荐。机甲塔防，5x5格子自由布阵，特效炫酷，自动升级挂机爽，策略丰富，性价比高。
塔防加弹幕太爽了，炮塔种类多布局自由，玩起来很解压！
节奏紧凑升级爽快，不同地图敌人特性各异，重玩性很高！
画面精良操作简单，挂机功能很贴心，不知不觉就玩了几小时！
肉鸽模式还可以，就是前期有点难扛，刷出来高阶炮塔还是挺爽的。
在5×5的格子中自由搭配炮台，选择还挺多的，还有自动升级功能，炮台放满就开着自动升级可以安心挂机了，挺好的
总体还行，创意不错，但是平衡性做的不好，后期的重复度也高，看以后有没有更新吧
塔防加卡牌组合的玩法太上头了！5x5的格子虽然小，但炮塔combo搭配好了伤害爆炸，比如引力炮聚怪再接个溅射，满屏数字看着就爽
挂机流塔防太适合我这种懒人了，前期摆好阵型就能看戏，失败了就回来调整一下再战，轻松又解压。不同地图敌人路线还不一样，挺有意思的
炮塔种类还挺丰富的，机炮、导弹啥的数值差异明显。而且炮塔还能自动升级，后期看着自己的防线越来越强，成就感满满
是我喜欢的类型，只要在这一块区域里放置炮台就好了，不需要像幸存者那样跑来跑去，而且炮塔种类还挺多的，玩起来很舒服
小成本塔防游戏，特效和UI再好一点就好了
机甲、塔防、挂机这几个要素集合在一起，兼具策略性和爽感

This game totally oversells itself. So do all the surprsingly large list of positive reviews. Something doesn't tie up. Its a barebones games, but the bit it does have, IS GREAT! Really! Buts way less than it comes across as.... Look, I dont have the capacity to list everything that is missing with this "full game" so off the top of my head: -70+ unique towers? Yeah right. There are no more than a small handful of turrents, like 10 or so, but all they do is variate in colour and strength. Walla, 70+ "unique" turrets. -NONE of the turrents tell you their damage range. So when you choose something, you stuck with it, because the only way you can see distance, is actually having a tower ready to place. There are no indications when you are choosing/buying a turrent. Let me tell you that for this kind of game, you flipping well need it. There is no reason for it to be missing. BUT, this game is not the only one guilty of that. I can name at least another two that also dont. Its tardy, lazy, or an inocent oversight :D -You cant destroy, replace, or move turrents. -Once you have chosen one, you have to use it. You cant escape and choose a different one, even if you chose the wrong one by accident. -No camera control, not even i half baked zoom function. The graphics are nice, but NOT great. NOT GREAT. I wish I could say more, but let me wrap up, I should be playing games instead of moaning about how this game sold itself as amazing, and strategic, and varied, but is none of those. I feel mislead, by the positive reviews, and the game itself. Fix the game, add new levels, tweak some settings, then maybe it will have more enduring charm. Until then, look at a couple of other tower defence games, and get ideas of how to replicate similar things in this game. If this situation changes, I WILL come back and change the rating and review :-)
